title: Money sense
promise: Budgets, fair deals, saving, and spotting traps.
introMarkdown:
## Money sense

Money is a tool. This pathway helps you plan a small budget and notice unfair deals.

No get-rich schemes. Just clearer choices.

supported.coachNote: Use small round numbers in local currency.

steady.coachNote: Ask needs vs wants with examples.

fast.coachNote: Add a save goal with weeks to target.

llm.tutorBrief: No gambling tips. No crypto hype. No shame about poverty. Use local currency when personalizing. Stay educational.
